_comment: The weekly review's fixed rule (qtrade/intraday/weekly_review.py). Backtest Sharpes are annualised, 0 bp fees like the sheet, from the most recent test period of each rule's study (results branch): momentum_flip = flip_check.md gross 2021-26 (0.33); auction_overnight = intraday_strategies.csv, second half, last30 fade (+1.74) and overnight persistence (+0.59) blended (~1.2); adr = asia_adr_strategy.csv, FX lagged a day, 0 bp, 2015-26 (2.91); foreign = foreign_strategies.csv, overnight persistence 2021-26 across the 8 markets, conservatively 1.5. A null backtest Sharpe marks a $0 tracker (information only). Change the rule only before a review, never because of one.
